Dynamical Systems to Machine Learning and Quantum Computing
Abstract: The central question of my talk is what can the mathematics of dynamical systems theory and complex systems theory tell us about machine learning and future quantum computing? Universality for Monotone Cellular Automata
Abstract:In this talk I will discuss a monotone version of the Ising model on Z^d, in which sites update from 0 to 1 (but not in the other direction) according to an arbitrary monotone, homogeneous, finite-range update rule.
